errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei Sätze von gestapelten Balken, wobei jeder Satz einen bestimmten Zeitraum repräsentiert.
errors.evidence: The figure shows one stacked bar chart on the left and one separate bar/line chart on the right, not two sets of stacked bars. The right panel contains bars plus a black line, and the left and right panels are distinct subplots.

errors.text_span: Der zweite Satz, der die Jahre 2000 bis 2023 umfasst, besteht aus einem schwarzen Linienplot, der „Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt“ darstellt.
errors.evidence: The black line spans the same 1991–2023 timeline in both panels; it is not only the 2000–2023 period or a separate second set of bars. The right panel’s bars are colored blue, purple, and green, with the black line overlaid.

errors.text_span: Eine vertikale gestrichelte Linie unterteilt das Diagramm bei 2000.
errors.evidence: There is a dashed vertical reference line at 2000 in both panels, but it does not divide the entire figure into separate data sets as implied by the surrounding text.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of two side-by-side panels/subplots.
The description omits the legend labels and their mapping to colors/line: Bund (blue), Länder (purple), Gemeinden (green), Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt (black line).
The description does not mention the annotation arrow and label 'Bahnreform²' above the dashed line.
